def VTask.replaceVertex {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) (s t : V) [DecidableEq V] : SimpleGraph V :=
  {
    adj := fun v w => if v = t then G.Adj s w ∧ w ≠ t else if w = t then G.Adj s v ∧ v ≠ t else G.Adj v w
    loopless := by
      intro v
      have h_main : ¬(if v = t then (G.Adj s v ∧ v ≠ t) else if v = t then (G.Adj s v ∧ v ≠ t) else G.Adj v v) := by
        by_cases h : v = t
        · -- Case: v = t
          simp [h]
          <;>
          (try simp_all [SimpleGraph.loopless]) <;>
          (try tauto)
        · -- Case: v ≠ t
          simp [h]
          <;>
          (try simp_all [SimpleGraph.loopless]) <;>
          (try tauto)
      simpa using h_main
  }
